basic_profile.bio: I'm a 16-year-old high school student from Texas. I love tinkering with gadgets, especially smartphones and tech gear. I'm not a fan of long lectures or essays, which is ironic because I spend a lot of my free time on Reddit reading and learning about new things. I’m usually online in the evenings after school and on weekends. I work part-time at a local electronics store, where I get to play with all the latest tech. I'm single and enjoy the freedom it gives me to explore my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I’m a self-taught tech enthusiast. Most of my knowledge comes from online forums, YouTube videos, and trial and error. I love learning about new technology, especially smartphones and operating systems.
